semantic_formula: Per segment:2*TP/(G+TP+FP); TP=sum of atom credit 0/0.5/1, G=gold atom count, FP=count of distinct false/unsupported substantive assertions. Equal dialect weight, equal segment weight within dialect.
partial_rule: 0.5 only when a gold proposition has meaningful correct content but omits a qualifier or argument; a reversed core relation/polarity/event receives0. Matching fragments alone do not count as the full proposition.
fp_rule: Count each distinct positive false/unsupported proposition once; repetitions do not multiply FP. Do not count explicit unknowns, harmless connective paraphrases, or rendering supplied dialect labels as invented content.
organization_rule: 5*mean of segment values:half for nonempty correctly assigned cues in the source segment, half for valid nonoverlapping timestamps,<=2 lines,<=22 nonspace chars/line and reading speed<=9chars/sec. Boundaries have0.25s tolerance; no phoneme timing gold.
delivery_rule: SRT parses and mapping covers all segments:1; validMKV:1; matching original video elementary stream:1; matching original audio elementary stream:1; extractedMKVsubtitle matchesSRT:1.
ground_truth: Existing YuBao original transcript and Mandarin translation; explicit relational atoms derived before solver run.
